description: The oath of vengeance binds a paladin to seek justice against wrongdoers.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.description: Weapon attacks against creatures that wronged you deal extra damage.

features.name: Vow of Enmity
features.description: Channel Divinity to gain advantage on attack vs one creature.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.description: Deal damage when enemy passes through your space.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.description: Reaction unarmed strike when enemy casts spell near you.
